title: Paving Installation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install a new paved patio and connecting pathway at 12 Acacia Avenue, Burleigh Heads. The patio is five metres by four metres, and the pathway is ten metres long by one point two metres wide, connecting from the patio to the side gate. This includes excavation to one hundred and fifty millimetres depth, laying geotextile fabric, and installing one hundred millimetres of compacted road base. A thirty-millimetre bedding sand layer will be used for thirty-two square metres of 'Coastal Grey' forty-millimetre thick concrete pavers. The perimeter will have twenty-eight linear metres of 'Charcoal' concrete border pavers installed as edge restraints. Finish with polymeric jointing sand and a final clean-up.
workingDetail: Pavers (clay, concrete, or natural stone), Road base / crushed rock, Bedding sand, Polymeric jointing sand
